name: motion-foundry

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,studio -c orange,cyan "npm run dev -w @motion-foundry/api" "npm run dev -w @motion-foundry/studio"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @motion-foundry/core && npm run build -w @motion-foundry/studio && npm run build -w @motion-foundry/api && npm run build -w @motion-foundry/cli && npm run build -w @motion-foundry/mcp

description: Local, agent-first motion production with a shared Studio, CLI, HTTP API and MCP server.
